label: For "Healthcare Workforce Absence & Sick Leave Forecasting": Forecast aggregate absence levels by role, unit, location and shift so leaders can size contingency staffing, using aggregate data only and never inferring any individual's health. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training with individual reasons.
